name: OrangeDeck Bitcoin Dashboard
description: Live view of the Bitcoin mempool: the latest block in the middle, the mempool as a pile below, new transactions raining in from above. Feed, clock, miner (several devices, optional public-pool page), market and explorer views. Data comes from mempool.space or a mempool instance you set, your own node included, the market view also from Binance, OKX and Bybit. Starts the optional OrangeDeck service if it is installed.
author: Satoshoe
